visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman in a blue denim shirt, a straw hat, and black gloves standing amidst tall, green water bamboo plants. She holds a small sickle and carefully harvests the stalks under bright, natural daylight. The background is filled with dense green foliage. (2) The scene shifts to a collection of harvested vegetables on the ground, including water bamboo stalks and taro. The woman then appears in a different section of the farm, pointing towards a trellis with climbing vines and yellow flowers. (3) She is seen harvesting a green loofah from the trellis, smiling brightly at the camera. The setting is an open field with mountains visible in the far distance under a clear blue sky. (4) The woman moves to a sweet potato field, bending down to dig into the soil. She pulls out a large cluster of purple-skinned sweet potatoes, looking triumphant and joyful. (5) Finally, she walks along a dirt path carrying a white bucket filled with sweet potatoes, followed by shots of her picking green leafy vegetables in a different patch of the garden. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 快樂農場採收. [Variety]: 原來茭白筍長這樣？. (2) [Subtitle]: 原來茭白筍長這麼長都不知道. (3) [Subtitle]: 第一次採收茭白筍好開心喔～. (4) [Subtitle]: 茭白筍田下面都是泥濘地. (5) [Subtitle]: 因為我沒有青蛙裝只能採收前面的. (6) [Subtitle]: 喔～這根太小了. (7) [Subtitle]: 我爸幫我採收這麼多茭白筍. (8) [Subtitle]: 這邊是絲瓜田... (9) [Subtitle]: 你看這條好小喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 來採收絲瓜囉～. (11) [Subtitle]: 採收完畢～. (12) [Subtitle]: 誒..又發現一條。。哈哈. (13) [Subtitle]: 我媽媽還種了很多地瓜. (14) [Subtitle]: 挖到一大串，開心～. (15) [Subtitle]: 地瓜超多，感覺拔不完... (16) [Subtitle]: 好囉，大豐收～. (17) [Subtitle]: 現在才知道原來種地瓜的地瓜葉沒辦法吃. (18) [Subtitle]: 要吃的地瓜葉要另外種. (19) [Subtitle]: 種菜真的很辛苦. (20) [Subtitle]: 我才摘這一點，就滿身大汗了. (21) [Subtitle]: 大家以後去市場買菜，不要殺價. (22) [Subtitle]: 之後再跟大家分享茭白筍的料理. (23) [Logo]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Slogan]: 當農夫太辛苦了...
